questions.question: What does qemu -kernel kernel.elf do?
options: Loads your ELF as the guest OS and boots it
questions.explanation: -kernel hands QEMU your binary as the thing to boot.

questions.question: Why does boot.s set %esp before calling C?
options: C needs a stack for call/return and locals
questions.explanation: call pushes a return address; without a stack the CPU faults.

questions.question: What do -S -s mean to QEMU?
options: Freeze CPU at start + expose GDB on :1234
questions.explanation: -S freezes, -s is shorthand for gdb tcp::1234.

questions.question: serial_putc spins on 0x20. What is it waiting for?
questions.explanation: Line-status bit 5 = THR empty; polling, no interrupts yet.

questions.question: make qemu exits 124. Good or bad?
options: Good: timeout killed QEMU after showing serial (expected, it halts forever)
questions.explanation: 124 = timeout's normal kill; the guest never exits by design.
